jobs.symbol: A crowned leader's flag marked R1.
jobs.description: Ranked 1st after the first round, including a shared lead.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE compact achievement emblem inside an existing badge frame, with a genuinely transparent background.
Reference image: style reference only. Match its clean ivory enamel faces, polished warm gold edges, shallow raised bevel, restrained dark edge and upper-left highlights. Bold simple silhouette, readable at 48 pixels, front-facing, centered with generous empty transparent margin on all sides. No outer badge frame, scenery, backing plate, decorative sparkles, extra icons or cast shadow outside the subject.
Subject: one compact ivory flag on a short gold pole, the flag bearing the large clear gold text "R1" for Round 1. A small simple three-point gold crown is attached to the top of the pole, indicating the tournament leader. Flag is a broad horizontal rectangle with a shallow notch on its right edge. Keep the pole short so the broad flag dominates; text readable at small size. Only one flag and one crown, no base or floor. Text (verbatim): "R1".

jobs.name: Finish Top Ten
jobs.description: Finished in the top 10 in a tournament’s final standings.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist tournament achievement emblem, a transparent PNG cutout for the center of a hexagonal game badge.
Style: match a clean raised enamel pictogram collection. Broad solid geometric shapes, almost-flat smooth faces, narrow polished beveled edges, thin dark perimeter, gentle upper-left highlights. Front-on orthographic view. Warm gold and ivory only, except when a specific medal metal is requested below. Consistent restrained depth, no texture, no photographic detail. Instantly recognizable at 48 pixels tall.
Composition: one compact balanced centered emblem occupying around 75 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent margins; every part fully visible. Genuinely transparent background and open negative spaces. No opaque or translucent backdrop, no stray pixels or haze.
Do not add a badge frame, hexagon, backing disc, laurels, wings, sparkles, scene, shadows on an imaginary background, letters, words, labels or extra objects. Only include numerals when explicitly requested below. Produce a single asset, not a contact sheet.
Subject: the exact numeral "10" as one bold compact typographic emblem. Large upright thick sans-serif digits with broad ivory faces and very narrow warm gold beveled edges, both digits equal height and clearly separated. The zero has a large clean transparent opening. No ordinal suffix, no ribbon, no extra symbols. Clear, simple, stable achievement mark, with the numeral filling the silhouette.
jobs.edit_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied ivory and gold 10 achievement emblem. Remove ALL background, black backdrop, gold glow, haze and shadow around the digits AND within the opening of the zero. Return ONLY the exact two numerals as a crisp clean cutout on genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve their existing shape, face colors, bevels, highlights, spacing and proportions. Nothing else may be changed or added. The zero's hole and the gap between 1 and 0 must be completely transparent. No drop shadow or semi-transparent halo. Fit the whole preserved 10 centered on a square transparent canvas with generous empty margins.

Do not include a badge frame, backing disc, hexagon, medal, ribbon, laurel, letters, numerals, face, sparkles, extra objects or a scene. Produce one asset, not a contact sheet.

rules.im-gonna-win: Ranked first in the standings after Round 1, including all players sharing that lead.
rules.im-in-the-lead: Ranked first in the standings after Round 2, including all players sharing that lead.
rules.wooden-spoon: In a completed tournament, this player has the largest numeric rank in the official final standings, and that rank is greater than 1. Include all players sharing last place. Use the worst actual rank, not participant count, because tied ranks may skip places. Works with or without a played Final. A last-place finish at one table is insufficient.
